column1: # Expected effective rights of v9-asked-free-resource (P/02.5 N1.4):
# - console writes vb/asked/* (vb has requests.per_person), not va/asked/* (va has no per_person);
# - vbworker and vbcontroller do not read vb/asked/* (!vb/asked/*);
# - resource writes/reads/deletes vb/requests/free-* (vb has requests.free: true), not vb/requests/r1 or va/requests/free-*;
# - resource reads the holds table (vb/notches/*) and unit rows of a manifest with about (vb/things/*), but not ordinary table vb/shelves/* or va/items/* rows without about.
# - resource does not read the slot family <s>/holds/* for either vb (with holds) or va (without holds): resource gets only <M>/<holds.table>/*
#   (C02-RESOURCE-HOLDS-TABLE-01; the Architect's decision, 2026-10-30; Gemini audit norm questions, P/02 item 1).
